title: Strategy Classification System — Bot vs Engine vs Anchor

BOT.execution: Immediate. No state machine. Just execute.

ENGINE.description: State machine. Multi-phase. Waits for confirmation.
ENGINE.trigger: Cascade forming, BTC confirming, temporal lags active
ENGINE.execution: State machine: DORMANT → ANCHOR → IGNITION → CASCADE 1 → CASCADE 2 → SPILLWAY → EXTRACTION

ANCHOR.description: Capital preservation. Low risk. Safe harbor.
ANCHOR.trigger: Market unclear, high volatility, uncertainty, Fear & Greed extreme
ANCHOR.execution: Preserve. Don't chase. Wait for clarity.

OBSERVE.description: New pattern. Experimental. Not yet trusted.
OBSERVE.trigger: Pattern detected but confidence < 60%, new obscure strategy
examples: Generated by ForgeLord, not yet validated
OBSERVE.execution: Watch. Log. Don't trade real capital.

decision_matrix.reason: High confidence, clear pattern – execute fast
Cascade forming – let state machine ride
Market extreme or unclear – bank safe
